title: 第1章 直播算命，两死一伤-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    凌晨2点。

    无数还在刷手机的夜猫子们，统一在主页推荐看到了一个封面漆黑的直播间。

    《七日后诡异降临全球|本周三卦，大凶》

    直播间里，光线昏黄，一个面色苍白的年轻女人正对着镜头。

    虽然容貌美丽，但这苍白的面色，与面无表情注视着镜头的样子，还是把夜猫子们吓了一跳。

    【这是干啥呢？吓我一跳】

    【我蹲十分钟了！主播该不会是个哑巴吧？】

    直播间里面的人数还在刷刷上涨。

    镜头里苍白美丽的年轻女人视线移动，似乎看到观众数量达到100，薄唇轻启，像僵硬的人偶在尝试说话。

    她的声音沙哑：

    “第一卦。

    安和小区C栋，今日凌晨两点十七分，二号电梯钢缆断裂，轿厢坠落。

    乘客三人，两死一伤。”

    【？？？现在的算命的都这么敢吹了？！】

    【太假了吧，我就住安和小区，这里是高级精品小区诶，电梯每个月都会质检，不可能有这么低级的事故！】

    【造谣呢吧，网警呢？没人管吗？】

    主播就像没看到大家的质疑，自顾自拿起水杯。

    正要喝水，“砰”一声巨响。

    主播身后的卧室门被人粗鲁地踹开。

    一个身材微胖的中年妇女叉着腰冲进来，凶狠大吼：

    “靳烂缺！你躲在屋里装什么死？

    刚才跟你说你哥买新房首付得三十万，你瞎了？为啥不回我消息？！”

    女人身后走进来一个身材高大的中年男人，挺着啤酒肚，夹烟的手直指靳兰玦鼻尖：

    “你今天必须把你那张卡交出来！不然我打断你的腿！”

    最后面，矮胖的青年靠着门框发出幸灾乐祸的笑声。

    主播侧头看过去，苍白的脸上古井无波，面对这样凶神恶煞的家人，她看上去十分平静。

    就像……已经见惯了，习惯得激不起半点波澜。

    【卧槽吓我一跳，手机都掉脸上了！】

    【难怪主播神神叨叨的，原来是在家受气，跑网上来装神弄鬼博关注了】

    【这该不会是剧本吧？】

    靳兰玦看了眼手机旁的虚空，那里有一行血红的黑体字迹漂浮在空中。

    【人气值：+23。】
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

2 o'clock in the morning.

Countless night owls who were still browsing their mobile phones saw a live broadcast room with a dark cover recommended on the homepage.

"Seven days from now, strange things will come to the world | Three hexagrams this week, big bad news"

In the live broadcast room, the light was dim, and a pale young woman was facing the camera.

Although the appearance is beautiful, the pale complexion and the expressionless way he stares at the camera still scare the night owls.

【What is this for?Scared me]

【I have been squatting for ten minutes!Could it be that the anchor is mute?】

The number of people in the live broadcast room is still rising.

The pale and beautiful young woman in the camera moved her gaze as if she saw the number of viewers reaching 100. Her thin lips opened slightly, like a stiff doll trying to speak.

Her voice was hoarse:

"The first hexagram.

In Building C of Anhe Community, at 2:17 this morning, the steel cable of the No. 2 elevator broke and the car fell.

There were three passengers, two dead and one injured."

【???Are today’s fortune tellers so bold to brag?!】

【That’s too fake. I live in Anhe Community. This is a high-end boutique community. The elevators are inspected every month. There is no way there is such a low-level accident!】

【You are spreading rumors, where are the Internet police?No one cares?】

The anchor didn’t seem to notice everyone’s doubts and picked up the water glass by himself.

Just as I was about to drink water, there was a loud "bang".

The bedroom door behind the anchor was kicked open rudely.

A fat middle-aged woman rushed in with her hands on her hips and shouted fiercely:

"Jin Langque! Why are you hiding in the house and pretending to be dead?

“I just told you that your brother had a down payment of 300,000 yuan to buy a new house. Are you blind?Why don't you reply to my message?!"

A tall middle-aged man walked in behind the woman, with a beer belly and the hand holding the cigarette pointed directly at the tip of Jin Lanjue's nose:

"You must hand over your card today! Otherwise I will break your legs!"

At the very back, a pudgy young man leaned against the doorframe and let out a gloating laugh.

The anchor looked sideways, her pale face unwavering. Facing such a fierce family member, she looked very calm.

It’s like... I’m used to it, so used to it that I can’t make any waves.

【Oh my God, I was so shocked that my phone fell off my face!】

【No wonder the anchor is so nagging, it turns out he was angry at home and went online to show off and gain attention】

【Could this be a script?】

Jin Lanjue glanced at the void next to the phone, where there was a line of blood-red black letters floating in the air.

【Popularity value: +23.】
